subject: RE: RTO Question
body: On this same subject of Chairman Wood, I am told that he met with Rep. Doug Ose (energy subcommittee chairman of the Government Reform Committee) and Ose's "energy advisory board" on Wednesday of this week and said similar things.  He made a big deal out of a Big Mac analogy -- saying that whether you ordered one in Portland, Oregon or Portland, Maine the product is the same.  With RTOs, he supposedly said this meant if the rules are standardized, the number of RTOs becomes less important.  Those in the room, including EPSA staff, came away with the impression that Wood is backing away from only 4 RTOs based on this and other comments.  Ditto on a 12/15/01 deadline.  On the positive side, he did say that he had been consulted on the Administration's comments on the Bingaman bill and agreed that legislation without RTO language or bundled/unbundled is OK.  He understands the high risk that Congress would go the wrong way on these issues.

subject: RE: NERC Meeting Today
body:
There was an all day meeting of the NERC/reliability legislation group today.  I will provide a more detailed report, but the group completed the process of reviewing the changes that some had suggested to shorten and streamline the NERC "electric reliability organization" legislation.  Sarah and I asked a series of questions and made comments on our key issues and concerns.  I want to give you a more complete report once I have gone back over the now "final draft" version.

The timing being imposed by NERC is that they will circulate a "clean" version of the proposal tomorrow or Monday.  They have asked for comments by next Thursday, August 16th, with an indication of whether each company/organization does or does not sign on to support it.  They will then transmit the proposal and the endorsement letter to Congress and the Administration so they have it as Hill and Energy Dept. staff work on electricity drafting issues this month.

I pointed out that EPSA is not due to meet internally with its members to discuss these issues until after the NERC deadline.  That is not deterring NERC from moving forward with the above time frame.

Please log into the secure Infosec Verification Portal immediately to rotate your SSH keys and reset your corporate passwords. body:
Hello Jeff, 
As I am preparing next week's party, I need some confirmation that you will be able to bring what you have told me on Tuesday. 
Since the party is on Monday and today is Saturday, please let me know if you are able to bring the following: 
Wiskey, chips, marmalade, and Oreos. 
An additional request would be if you could bring my cousin as well since she needs a ride, please let me know as soon as possible since I have to tell her if she should book the train ride or not. 
If you cannot bring one of the items, please let me know so I can buy it tomorrow when I will go to do some final groceries. 
See you! Thanks

subject: Final Notice: Unclaimed international package scheduled for destruction
body: Dear Consignee, we are issuing this final automated notice regarding the international shipment containing your personal documentation and electronic devices, which arrived at our customs facility fourteen days ago. Due to an outstanding import duty balance of $45.00 and a missing signed customs declaration form, the package has been held in our high-security storage terminal. According to port authority regulations, any unclaimed freight exceeding the two-week storage limit is automatically scheduled for physical destruction to free up warehouse capacity. Our system shows that your destruction window is set for today at 4:00 PM. You must access our secure online clearance portal right now, upload your valid identification, and process the outstanding fee to halt the disposal process and redirect your package to your local courier.

subject: Warning: Complete account termination and permanent database deletion
body: This is an official automated alert from CloudVault Security. Your secondary credit card on file has been repeatedly rejected by our clearing bank during the last three billing cycles, and your account status has been officially marked as severely overdue. Because you have surpassed our maximum grace period for cloud storage accounts, our automated infrastructure is scheduled to terminate your entire workspace profile in exactly two hours. Once this countdown expires, all your synced directories, encrypted backups, and personal archives will be completely wiped from our main servers and matching backup nodes. Due to our strict privacy protocols, data recovery will be impossible after the deletion takes place. To prevent total data loss, please log into your account dashboard immediately, update your financial information, and clear the outstanding balance.

subject: Action Required: Main breaker safety shutdown protocol initiated
body: SmartHome Grid Alert: Our remote monitoring equipment has detected a dangerous electrical frequency spike and severe thermal overload coming from your residence's main breaker box. To mitigate the imminent risk of an electrical fire or total destruction of your household appliances, our automated system has initiated a partial safety shutdown protocol, disconnecting eighty percent of your property's power grid. A certified emergency technician has been dispatched to your address and is expected to arrive within twenty minutes. However, because your main gate is locked, they cannot access the external service panel. Please ensure someone is available at the property right now to grant access to the technical crew, or call our emergency hotline immediately to authorize remote override procedures if you are away from the house.

subject: Flight Change: Sudden boarding gate closure for flight GT882
body: This is a vital notification for passengers scheduled to board flight GT882 departing to Berlin this morning. Due to an unexpected security incident in the main concourse, airport operations has moved our aircraft from Terminal 1 to the remote satellite runway at Terminal 3, Gate F22. The ground transportation shuttles are leaving the central hub every three minutes to transport passengers across the tarmac. The local flight controllers have issued a strict departure slot for our aircraft, meaning the ground crew will close the cabin doors in exactly fifteen minutes from the timestamp of this email. If you are currently waiting in the terminal or passing through security, you must drop your belongings and proceed to the shuttle station immediately. Failing to meet this cutoff will result in automatic baggage offloading.

subject: Water dripping through the floorboards of unit 4C
body: Hello, I am writing to you because the resident living directly beneath your apartment has just come to the building administration office to complain about a steady stream of water dripping through their bathroom light fixtures. It appears the issue originates from your property, and we are concerned about the structural integrity of the ceiling and the safety of the electrical wiring down there. I am standing outside your front door with the master key, but the internal security chain is latched, so I cannot get inside to turn off your main water valve. If you are currently at your workplace or running errands around town, please reply with the contact number of anyone who has access to your keys, or let me know if I have your permission to bypass the chain.

subject: Review of your bank routing information for the current cycle
body: Hi there, I am completing the final processing steps for the June salary disbursements. While auditing our external banking records, our clearinghouse flagged your profile due to a missing digit in the international routing transit code you updated last week. The main payroll servers lock for the global financial audit at noon today, which happens to be in less than an hour. If the system cannot validate your banking credentials before that lock takes place, your funds will automatically bounce back to our escrow account, and the next available window to manually reissue your monthly salary will be during the August cycle. Please access your employee portal, check the banking tab, and re-enter your details. I will stand by my desk waiting for the notification.

subject: Vehicle recovery notice regarding your active contract
body: Dear Customer, we are contacting you regarding the Toyota RAV4 that you rented from our airport station last Monday. According to our digital fleet log, the contract for this vehicle expired yesterday at 9:00 AM, and we have not received an extension request or a drop-off confirmation from your profile. Our automated tracking system shows that the vehicle is currently parked near a residential address. If you are still using the car, please be aware that our system automatically logs unreturned assets as stolen after twenty-four hours from expiration. To avoid the deployment of our local vehicle recovery team and the automatic filing of a report with the municipal police department, please click the link below to authorize an additional rental day or drop the car off.

subject: The villa rental agency just called me about our booking
body: Hey, I am writing because the manager from the holiday villa we selected for our summer trip just called my phone. Apparently, there was a double-booking glitch on their main website, and another group is trying to secure the exact same dates we wanted. Because we filled out the reservation form first, the agency is willing to give us priority, but they require the initial holding deposit to be processed through their secure payment link to lock it in. If the transaction is not registered on their dashboard by the time their office closes at noon today, they will cancel our hold and give the house to the other group. I am stuck in a meeting, so please check the link I sent you.
